data.one_liner: An animated expandable search bar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated search bar widget that expands and collapses. It allows customization of width, background color, text, icon color, shadows, animation duration, and animation curve.
use_when: You want a searchable UI component with built-in expansion animations
You are developing for mouse devices like Web, Windows, macOS, or Linux where the package is documented to work
avoid_when: You need immediate robust support for mobile devices, as the package note states it is currently only available on mouse devices
You need advanced font styling and color controls out-of-the-box, which are listed as pending goals
strengths: Easy to integrate and use in Flutter layouts
Offers multiple visual customization properties like shadows, colors, and durations
weaknesses: Currently restricted to mouse-based devices (Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Lacks direct built-in options to change font style and color
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import it in your Dart code.
